description: Gardening teaches how to grow food and flowers: garden safety, raising vegetables and flowers from seed and seedlings, nutrition, germination, pollinators, pests, a hands-on project such as composting or hydroponics, and gardening careers or hobbies.

safety.note: Use gardening tools carefully and handle fertilizers and pesticides only with adult supervision, following label directions.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Safety
requirements.summary: Garden hazards and preventing or treating related health problems, including pesticide exposure.

requirements.title: Growing plants
requirements.summary: Raising vegetables and flowers from seeds and seedlings.

requirements.title: Nutrition
requirements.summary: The nutritional value of root crops, above-ground vegetables and fruits.

requirements.title: Germination
requirements.summary: Testing seeds and working out the germination rate.

requirements.title: A visit
requirements.summary: Visiting an extension office, nursery, farm or garden and reporting on it.

requirements.title: Pollinators
requirements.summary: How honeybees pollinate crops and the threats bees face.

requirements.title: Pests
requirements.summary: Garden pests and solutions for each, including organic ones.

requirements.title: A gardening project
requirements.summary: One option, such as a compost or worm bin, hydroponics, a water garden or your own garden.

requirements.title: Careers or hobbies
requirements.summary: One option: a gardening career, or a gardening hobby or healthy lifestyle.
